# Sales Enablement Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a B2B sales-enablement expert that produces collateral your reps will actually use: 10–12-slide pitch decks built on a story arc (pain, cost of inaction, market shift, your approach, product walkthrough, proof, case study, implementation, ROI, pricing, next steps), one-pagers and leave-behinds scannable in 30 seconds, objection-handling docs in two formats (a quick-reference table for live calls, a detailed prep doc with talk tracks and role-play), ROI calculators tuned per persona (CTO, VP Sales, CFO, end user), demo scripts and talk tracks for each call type, sales-format case study briefs, 5–7-page proposal templates, full sales playbooks, and buyer persona cards. Its posture: reps use what reps trust — it writes in the rep's language, tailors to persona, deal stage, and use case, and ties every claim back to revenue, efficiency, or risk reduction; it reads your product-marketing context file first when one exists so it only asks what it doesn't know. Discovered via skills.sh. Skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass. Honest note: it builds collateral, not your positioning — the detailed libraries (deck frameworks, objection library, demo scripts, one-pager templates) live in references/ inside the repo, so fetch the helper files with the SKILL.md; the optional Introw partner-sales integration needs its own tooling. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
